title: Android Intern | Female Candidate | 3 Months To 6 Months Experience
Flutter Developer
description:
Job Summary Position: Flutter Developer Location: Mohali Employment Type: Full-Time Department: Engineering About the Role We are looking for a passionate Flutter Developer with 2+ years of experience in developing high-quality Android and iOS applications. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience building scalable mobile applications, integrating REST APIs, managing offline data, and collaborating with backend and UI/UX teams. Key Responsibilities Develop and maintain Android and iOS applications using Flutter. Build reusable, clean, and maintainable Dart code. Integrate REST APIs and third-party SDKs. Collaborate with backend developers, QA engineers, and UI/UX designers. Develop responsive and pixel-perfect user interfaces. Implement state management using Provider, Bloc, Riverpod, GetX, or similar frameworks. Optimize application performance, memory usage, and startup time. Debug production issues and provide timely fixes. Work with local storage solutions such as Hive, or Shared Preferences. Implement push notifications using Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM). Participate in code reviews and follow coding standards. Maintain application security and implement best practices. Publish and maintain applications on Google Play Store and Apple App Store. Write technical documentation where required. Work in Agile/Scrum development environments. Required Skills 2+ years of experience in Flutter application development. Strong knowledge of Dart programming language. Experience with Flutter widgets, layouts, animations, and navigation. Good understanding of RESTful APIs and JSON. Experience with state management frameworks such as Provider, Bloc, Riverpod, GetX. Experience with local databases such as Hive. Knowledge of Firebase services: Firebase Authentication, Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM), Firebase Crashlytics, Firebase Analytics. Experience integrating third-party libraries and SDKs. Understanding of Git and version control workflows. Familiarity with Android Studio, VS Code, and Xcode. Knowledge of application lifecycle and mobile architecture patterns. Good to Have Experience with Maps (Google Maps/OpenStreetMap). Background location tracking. Camera integration and media uploads. Biometric authentication. Offline-first application development. WebSocket or Socket.IO integration. Deep Linking and Universal Links. CI/CD pipelines for Flutter applications. Fastlane, Codemagic, GitHub Actions, or Azure DevOps. Experience with payment gateway integrations. Knowledge of mobile application security best practices. Preferred Qualifications Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. Strong debugging and problem-solving skills. Good communication and teamwork abilities. Ability to estimate development tasks and meet deadlines. Experience working on enterprise or B2B applications is preferred. What You'll Work On Enterprise Flutter applications used by thousands of users. New feature development and product enhancements. Performance optimization and bug fixing. API integrations and backend collaboration. Release management for Android and iOS. Building scalable, secure, and maintainable mobile applications. Preferred Technical Stack Framework: Flutter Language: Dart Backend APIs: REST APIs State Management: Provider / Bloc / Riverpod / GetX Local Database: Hive Notifications: Firebase Cloud Messaging Analytics Crash Reporting: Firebase Analytics, Crashlytics Version Control: Git CI/CD: GitHub Actions / Codemagic / Azure DevOps (preferred)
